issues.on_page: 2022 Total: Cash and certificates of deposit 2,288,278 + Cash held by county treasurer 20,126 = TOTAL ASSETS 2,308,404
issues.issue: beginning_cash and ending_cash (2,341,504) are sums of two printed cash lines (marked computed) and equal the fund balance. The 2026-11-06 ruling says cash is filled only where printed and never derived; the only printed single figure is TOTAL ASSETS. They also include certificates of deposit

issues.on_page: Transportation 29,411 (General Fund 'Airport' p20; combined budget schedule p17 prints 'Transfer to Airport Authority 29,411')
issues.issue: This is a payment to a separate Airport Authority. Keeping it as spending follows the as-printed rule, and the category 'Airport' is a new name; a person could prefer grants/payments to other entities
Loans made to businesses (repaid later as 'Economic reuse - loan payments'), not grants; detail_category is a judgment call
Cost type not printed; 'other' with review. A specific category (e.g. a sanitation program or Professional/Contract Services) may fit
The cost-type category 'utilities' has the same name as the function category 'utilities', so these two lines can't be told apart from function lines by category
